run_compiler_gym_unrolling_env: run a compiler_gym unrolling environment with benchmark offsets1 and sample random actions
create_gym_env_with_make: create a gym environment using compiler_gym.make with unrolling-py-v0 and runtime reward space
reset_gym_env: reset the compiler_gym environment and retrieve the initial observation features
step_gym_env_with_sample_action: step the gym environment using a sampled action from the action space
set_compiler_gym_debug_level: set the compiler_gym debug level to 4 for verbose logging output
